title: Pricing Standard: Interest Rate Buydown Subsidy and Points Cost
content:
The cost of an Interest Rate Buydown is fixed when the buydown is approved: the monthly principal and interest at the note rate, the subsidy amount (0.00 for a permanent buydown) and the points cost (0.00 for a temporary buydown). The loan-year reductions and the discount points used are those of the elected product, on every one of the seven products.

## A. Temporary buydown: the subsidy amount

A.1 The **monthly principal and interest at the note rate** is the fully amortizing payment of the loan amount at the note rate over the loan term.

A.2 For each subsidized month, the **reduced payment** is computed at the note rate less that loan year's reduction, never below the product's lowest payment rate.

A.3 The **monthly difference** is the monthly principal and interest at the note rate less the reduced payment, rounded to the product's decimal places for each month's payment difference.

A.4 The **subsidy amount** is the sum of those differences over 12 months per buydown year, and it may not exceed the product's largest subsidy percent of the loan amount.

**Worked example (all inputs hypothetical).** Loan amount $320,000.00; note rate 6.875%; loan term 360 months; a two-year temporary product with a loan year 1 reduction of 2.000 and a loan year 2 reduction of 1.000; differences rounded to 2 decimal places; lowest payment rate 2.000%; largest subsidy 6.00% of the loan amount.

| Item | Loan year 1 | Loan year 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly principal and interest at 6.875% | $2,102.17 | $2,102.17 |
| Payment rate | 4.875% | 5.875% |
| Reduced payment at that rate | $1,693.47 | $1,892.92 |
| Monthly difference | $408.70 | $209.25 |
| Months | 12 | 12 |
| Year total | $4,904.40 | $2,511.00 |

The subsidy amount is $4,904.40 and $2,511.00 together, $7,415.40. The largest subsidy on this loan is 6.00% of $320,000.00, which is $19,200.00; $7,415.40 does not exceed it.

**The floor in the same terms (hypothetical).** On a note rate of 4.500% with a loan year 1 reduction of 3.000 and a lowest payment rate of 2.000%, the reduced payment for loan year 1 is computed at 2.000%, not at 1.500%.

## B. Permanent buydown: the points cost

B.1 The **points cost** is the product's discount points multiplied by the loan amount, divided by 100, rounded to the cent. The note rate is lowered by the product's note rate reduction.

B.2 The points count toward the qualified mortgage points and fees cap together with the other points and fees, and a buydown that would push the loan over the cap is refused.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A product with 2.000 discount points and a note rate reduction of 0.500, on a loan amount of $320,000.00 and a note rate of 6.875%: the points cost is 2.000 multiplied by $320,000.00, divided by 100, which is $6,400.00; the note rate becomes 6.375%.

| Other points and fees on the hypothetical loan | Together with the $6,400.00 points | Hypothetical cap of $9,600.00 |
|---|---|---|
| $3,000.00 | $9,400.00 | within the cap |
| $3,200.00 | $9,600.00 | within the cap |
| $3,500.00 | $9,900.00 | over the cap; the buydown is refused |

## C. Changes before consummation

Whenever the note rate or the loan amount changes before consummation, the cost is recomputed in the same update: the note rate and loan amount the buydown is computed on are updated together with the monthly principal and interest at the note rate, the subsidy amount and the points cost.
